g.text: Exact-N action traces; one sample per cell. SAT/UNSAT are solver responses; G:— means the query was not attempted because model setup failed. Shared batch setup measurements must not be summed across cells. PRE means preprocessing closed the goal.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5c6b76

g.text: Cell code = phase:limit. N nextSimp · H hoist · D destruct/dsimp · M smtSimp · I intros · E embedding · Z normalize · T translate · W serialize · G setup · V query/VC · Q solver.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5c6b76

g.text: Limits: S simp steps · R recursion · B heartbeat · P process cap · ! other error. G:— = unattempted because shared model setup failed.
